secondRaterTrue.line: **KVBM (KV Block Manager) is deprecated in v1.5.0 and removal is targeted for v1.6.0; the `kvbm` wheel and the vLLM KVBM launch and deploy examples ship unchanged for this release**.

**Rust EPP Frontend Image:** Shipped the Rust Endpoint Picker binary inside the Dynamo Frontend image at `/epp`, replacing the Go EPP. A standalone `dynamo-epp` image is planned for a later release (\#11355).

**Initial support for the Rust frontend**: Migrates the front half of the server, everything from network ingress up to the point a tokenized request is handed to the GPU scheduler, from Python to a multi-threaded Rust implementation ([#29799](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/29799)).
